24.he: מָה־רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ׀ יְֽהֹוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחׇכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃
24.en: How many are the things You have made, O LORD;You have made them all with wisdom;the earth is full of Your creations.

25.he: זֶ֤ה׀ הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֢ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
25.en: There is the sea, vast and wide,with its creatures beyond number,living things, small and great.

26.he: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־בּֽוֹ׃
26.en: There go the ships,and Leviathan that You formed to sport with.

27.he: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אׇכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
27.en: All of them look to Youto give them their food when it is due.

28.he: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃
28.en: Give it to them, they gather it up;open Your hand, they are well satisfied;

29.he: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃
29.en: hide Your face, they are terrified;take away their breath, they perishand turn again into dust;

30.he: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃
30.en: send back Your breath, they are created,and You renew the face of the earth.

31.he: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
31.en: May the glory of the LORD endure forever;may the LORD rejoice in His works!

32.he: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
32.en: He looks at the earth and it trembles;He touches the mountains and they smoke.

33.he: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהֹוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
33.en: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live;all my life I will chant hymns to my God.

34.he: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
34.en: May my prayer be pleasing to Him;I will rejoice in the LORD.

35.he: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים׀ מִן־הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים׀ ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
35.en: May sinners disappear from the earth,and the wicked be no more.Bless the LORD, O my soul.Hallelujah.

1.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃
1.en: Praise the LORD;call on His name;proclaim His deeds among the peoples.

2.he: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכׇל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
2.en: Sing praises to Him;speak of all His wondrous acts.

3.he: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהֹוָֽה׃
3.en: Exult in His holy name;let all who seek the LORD rejoice.

4.he: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהֹוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃
4.en: Turn to the LORD, to His might;seek His presence constantly.

5.he: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיו׃
5.en: Remember the wonders He has done,His portents and the judgments He has pronounced,

6.he: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
6.en: O offspring of Abraham, His servant,O descendants of Jacob, His chosen ones.

7.he: ה֭וּא יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכׇל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
7.en: He is the LORD our God;His judgments are throughout the earth.

8.he: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
8.en: He is ever mindful of His covenant,the promise He gave for a thousand generations,

9.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃
9.en: that He made with Abraham,swore to Isaac,

10.he: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃
10.en: and confirmed in a decree for Jacob,for Israel, as an eternal covenant,

11.he: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
11.en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaanas your allotted heritage.”

12.he: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
12.en: They were then few in number,a mere handful, sojourning there,

13.he: וַ֭יִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
13.en: wandering from nation to nation,from one kingdom to another.

14.he: לֹא־הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעׇשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃
14.en: He allowed no one to oppress them;He reproved kings on their account,

15.he: אַֽל־תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַ֗י אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
15.en: “Do not touch My anointed ones;do not harm My prophets.”

16.he: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כׇּֽל־מַטֵּה־לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃
16.en: He called down a famine on the land,destroyed every staff of bread.

17.he: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃
17.en: He sent ahead of them a man,Joseph, sold into slavery.

18.he: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל (רגליו) [רַגְל֑וֹ] בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
18.en: His feet were subjected to fetters;an iron collar was put on his neck.

19.he: עַד־עֵ֥ת בֹּא־דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃
19.en: Until his prediction came truethe decree of the LORD purged him.

20.he: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃
20.en: The king sent to have him freed;the ruler of nations released him.

21.he: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכׇל־קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃
21.en: He made him the lord of his household,empowered him over all his possessions,

22.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃
22.en: to discipline his princes at will,to teach his elders wisdom.

23.he: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־חָֽם׃
23.en: Then Israel came to Egypt;Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

24.he: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּעֲצִמֵ֗הוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃
24.en: He made His people very fruitful,more numerous than their foes.

25.he: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃
25.en: He changed their heart to hate His people,to plot against His servants.

26.he: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַר־בּֽוֹ׃
26.en: He sent His servant Moses,and Aaron, whom He had chosen.

27.he: שָֽׂמוּ־בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃
27.en: They performed His signs among them,His wonders, against the land of Ham.

28.he: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־[דְּבָרֽוֹ] (דבריו)׃
28.en: He sent darkness; it was very dark;did they not defy His word?

29.he: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָֽם׃
29.en: He turned their waters into bloodand killed their fish.

30.he: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃
30.en: Their land teemed with frogs,even the rooms of their king.

31.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכׇל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃
31.en: Swarms of insects came at His command,lice, throughout their country.

32.he: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
32.en: He gave them hail for rain,and flaming fire in their land.

33.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
33.en: He struck their vines and fig trees,broke down the trees of their country.

34.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
34.en: Locusts came at His command,grasshoppers without number.

35.he: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כׇּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃
35.en: They devoured every green thing in the land;they consumed the produce of the soil.

36.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כׇּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכׇל־אוֹנָֽם׃
36.en: He struck down every first-born in the land,the first fruit of their vigor.

37.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃
37.en: He led Israel out with silver and gold;none among their tribes faltered.

38.he: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
38.en: Egypt rejoiced when they left,for dread of Israel had fallen upon them.

39.he: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃
39.en: He spread a cloud for a cover,and fire to light up the night.

40.he: שָׁ֭אַל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃
40.en: They asked and He brought them quail,and satisfied them with food from heaven.

41.he: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃
41.en: He opened a rock so that water gushed forth;it flowed as a stream in the parched land.

42.he: כִּֽי־זָ֭כַר אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
42.en: Mindful of His sacred promiseto His servant Abraham,

43.he: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּחִירָֽיו׃
43.en: He led His people out in gladness,His chosen ones with joyous song.

44.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃
44.en: He gave them the lands of nations;they inherited the wealth of peoples,

45.he: בַּעֲב֤וּר׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
45.en: that they might keep His lawsand observe His teachings.Hallelujah.

1.he: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ׀ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
1.en: Hallelujah.Praise the LORD for He is good;His steadfast love is eternal.

2.he: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כׇּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
2.en: Who can tell the mighty acts of the LORD,proclaim all His praises?

3.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכׇל־עֵֽת׃
3.en: Happy are those who act justly,who do right at all times.

4.he: זׇכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פׇּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
4.en: Be mindful of me, O LORD, when You favor Your people;take note of me when You deliver them,

5.he: לִרְא֤וֹת׀ בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
5.en: that I may enjoy the prosperity of Your chosen ones,share the joy of Your nation,glory in Your very own people.

6.he: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
6.en: We have sinned like our forefathers;we have gone astray, done evil.

7.he: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם׀ לֹֽא־הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת־רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל־יָ֣ם בְּיַם־סֽוּף׃
7.en: Our forefathers in Egypt did not perceive Your wonders;they did not remember Your abundant love,but rebelled at the sea, at the Sea of Reeds.

8.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃
8.en: Yet He saved them, as befits His name,to make known His might.

9.he: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם־ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
9.en: He sent His blast against the Sea of Reeds;it became dry;He led them through the deep as through a wilderness.

10.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃
10.en: He delivered them from the foe,redeemed them from the enemy.

11.he: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר׃
11.en: Water covered their adversaries;not one of them was left.

12.he: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
12.en: Then they believed His promise,and sang His praises.

13.he: מִ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַֽעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹא־חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
13.en: But they soon forgot His deeds;they would not wait to learn His plan.

14.he: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֝֗ל בִּישִׁימֽוֹן׃
14.en: They were seized with craving in the wilderness,and put God to the test in the wasteland.

15.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃
15.en: He gave them what they asked for,then made them waste away.

16.he: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהֹוָֽה׃
16.en: There was envy of Moses in the camp,and of Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.

17.he: תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל־עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם׃
17.en: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan,closed over the party of Abiram.

18.he: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃
18.en: A fire blazed among their party,a flame that consumed the wicked.

19.he: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃
19.en: They made a calf at Horeband bowed down to a molten image.

20.he: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב׃
20.en: They exchanged their gloryfor the image of a bull that feeds on grass.

21.he: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
21.en: They forgot God who saved them,who performed great deeds in Egypt,

22.he: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃
22.en: wondrous deeds in the land of Ham,awesome deeds at the Sea of Reeds.

23.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵהַשְׁחִֽית׃
23.en: He would have destroyed themhad not Moses His chosen oneconfronted Him in the breachto avert His destructive wrath.

24.he: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃
24.en: They rejected the desirable land,and put no faith in His promise.

25.he: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאׇהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהֹוָֽה׃
25.en: They grumbled in their tentsand disobeyed the LORD.

26.he: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
26.en: So He raised His hand in oathto make them fall in the wilderness,

27.he: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
27.en: to disperse their offspring among the nationsand scatter them through the lands.

28.he: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים׃
28.en: They attached themselves to Baal Peor,ate sacrifices offered to the dead.

29.he: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַ֥עַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרׇץ־בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה׃
29.en: They provoked anger by their deeds,and a plague broke out among them.

30.he: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
30.en: Phinehas stepped forth and intervened,and the plague ceased.

31.he: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
31.en: It was reckoned to his meritfor all generations, to eternity.

32.he: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
32.en: They provoked wrath at the waters of Meribahand Moses suffered on their account,

33.he: כִּי־הִמְר֥וּ אֶת־רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃
33.en: because they rebelled against Himand he spoke rashly.

34.he: לֹֽא־הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃
34.en: They did not destroy the nationsas the LORD had commanded them,

35.he: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
35.en: but mingled with the nationsand learned their ways.

36.he: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
36.en: They worshiped their idols,which became a snare for them.

37.he: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת־בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּׁדִֽים׃
37.en: Their own sons and daughtersthey sacrificed to demons.

38.he: וַיִּ֥שְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם־בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃
38.en: They shed innocent blood,the blood of their sons and daughters,whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan;so the land was polluted with bloodguilt.

39.he: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנ֗וּ בְּמַ֥עַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
39.en: Thus they became defiled by their acts,debauched through their deeds.

40.he: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֣ף יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת־נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
40.en: The LORD was angry with His peopleand He abhorred His inheritance.

41.he: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃
41.en: He handed them over to the nations;their foes ruled them.

42.he: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃
42.en: Their enemies oppressed themand they were subject to their power.

43.he: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃
43.en: He saved them time and again,but they were deliberately rebellious,and so they were brought low by their iniquity.

44.he: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שׇׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם׃
44.en: When He saw that they were in distress,when He heard their cry,

45.he: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חֲסָדָֽו׃
45.en: He was mindful of His covenantand in His great faithfulness relented.

46.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כׇּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃
46.en: He made all their captors kindly disposed toward them.

47.he: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ׀ יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
47.en: Deliver us, O LORD our God,and gather us from among the nations,to acclaim Your holy name,to glory in Your praise.

48.he: בָּ֤רֽוּךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם׀ וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כׇּל־הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
48.en: Blessed is the LORD, God of Israel,From eternity to eternity.Let all the people say, “Amen.”Hallelujah.

1.he: הֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
1.en: “Praise the LORD, for He is good;His steadfast love is eternal!”

2.he: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃
2.en: Thus let the redeemed of the LORD say,those He redeemed from adversity,

3.he: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃
3.en: whom He gathered in from the lands,from east and west,from the north and from the sea.

4.he: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃
4.en: Some lost their way in the wilderness,in the wasteland;they found no settled place.

5.he: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃
5.en: Hungry and thirsty,their spirit failed.

6.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצ֥וּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃
6.en: In their adversity they cried to the LORD,and He rescued them from their troubles.

7.he: וַֽ֭יַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
7.en: He showed them a direct wayto reach a settled place.

8.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
8.en: Let them praise the LORD for His steadfast love,His wondrous deeds for mankind;

9.he: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה מִלֵּא־טֽוֹב׃
9.en: for He has satisfied the thirsty,filled the hungry with all good things.

10.he: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃
10.en: Some lived in deepest darkness,bound in cruel irons,

11.he: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃
11.en: because they defied the word of God,spurned the counsel of the Most High.

12.he: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃
12.en: He humbled their hearts through suffering;they stumbled with no one to help.

13.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻ֥קוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
13.en: In their adversity they cried to the LORD,and He rescued them from their troubles.

14.he: י֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
14.en: He brought them out of deepest darkness,broke their bonds asunder.

15.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
15.en: Let them praise the LORD for His steadfast love,His wondrous deeds for mankind;

16.he: כִּֽי־שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃
16.en: for He shattered gates of bronze,He broke their iron bars.

17.he: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺ֥נֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃
17.en: There were fools who suffered for their sinful way,and for their iniquities.

18.he: כׇּל־אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־שַׁ֥עֲרֵי־מָֽוֶת׃
18.en: All food was loathsome to them;they reached the gates of death.

19.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻ֥קוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
19.en: In their adversity they cried to the LORDand He saved them from their troubles.

20.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִֽיתוֹתָֽם׃
20.en: He gave an order and healed them;He delivered them from the pits.

21.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
21.en: Let them praise the LORD for His steadfast love,His wondrous deeds for mankind.

22.he: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃
22.en: Let them offer thanksgiving sacrifices,and tell His deeds in joyful song.

23.he: ׆ יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בׇּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃
23.en: Others go down to the sea in ships,ply their trade in the mighty waters;

24.he: ׆ הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃
24.en: they have seen the works of the LORDand His wonders in the deep.

25.he: ׆ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃
25.en: By His word He raised a storm windthat made the waves surge.

26.he: ׆ יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
26.en: Mounting up to the heaven,plunging down to the depths,disgorging in their misery,

27.he: ׆ יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכׇל־חׇ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃
27.en: they reeled and staggered like a drunken man,all their skill to no avail.

28.he: ׆ וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצ֥וּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃
28.en: In their adversity they cried to the LORD,and He saved them from their troubles.

29.he: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃
29.en: He reduced the storm to a whisper;the waves were stilled.

30.he: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃
30.en: They rejoiced when all was quiet,and He brought them to the port they desired.

31.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
31.en: Let them praise the LORD for His steadfast love,His wondrous deeds for mankind.

32.he: וִֽ֭ירוֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃
32.en: Let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people,acclaim Him in the assembly of the elders.

33.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃
33.en: He turns the rivers into a wilderness,springs of water into thirsty land,

34.he: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
34.en: fruitful land into a salt marsh,because of the wickedness of its inhabitants.

35.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
35.en: He turns the wilderness into pools,parched land into springs of water.

36.he: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
36.en: There He settles the hungry;they build a place to settle in.

37.he: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבוּאָֽה׃
37.en: They sow fields and plant vineyardsthat yield a fruitful harvest.

38.he: וַיְבָרְכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃
38.en: He blesses them and they increase greatly;and He does not let their cattle decrease,

39.he: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃
39.en: after they had been few and crushedby oppression, misery, and sorrow.

40.he: ׆ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃
40.en: He pours contempt on great menand makes them lose their way in trackless deserts;

41.he: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃
41.en: but the needy He secures from suffering,and increases their families like flocks.

42.he: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכׇל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
42.en: The upright see it and rejoice;the mouth of all wrongdoers is stopped.

43.he: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמׇר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
43.en: The wise man will take note of these things;he will consider the steadfast love of the LORD.

1.he: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
1.en: A song. A psalm of David.

2.he: נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
2.en: My heart is firm, O God;I will sing and chant a hymn with all my soul.

3.he: ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
3.en: Awake, O harp and lyre!I will wake the dawn.

4.he: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים׀יְהֹוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲזַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
4.en: I will praise You among the peoples, O LORD,sing a hymn to You among the nations;

5.he: כִּי־גָד֣וֹל מֵעַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד־שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
5.en: for Your faithfulness is higher than the heavens;Your steadfastness reaches to the sky.

6.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
6.en: Exalt Yourself over the heavens, O God;let Your glory be over all the earth!

7.he: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
7.en: That those whom You love may be rescued,deliver with Your right hand and answer me.

8.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקׇדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
8.en: God promised in His sanctuarythat I would exultingly divide up Shechem,and measure the Valley of Sukkoth;

9.he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד׀ לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
9.en: Gilead and Manasseh would be mine,Ephraim my chief stronghold,Judah my scepter;

10.he: מוֹאָ֤ב׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵי־פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃
10.en: Moab would be my washbasin;on Edom I would cast my shoe;I would raise a shout over Philistia.

11.he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃
11.en: Would that I were brought to the bastion!Would that I were led to Edom!

12.he: הֲלֹֽא־אֱלֹהִ֥ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאֹתֵֽינוּ׃
12.en: But You have rejected us, O God;God, You do not march with our armies.

13.he: הָבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
13.en: Grant us Your aid against the foe,for the help of man is worthless.

14.he: בֵּאלֹהִ֥ים נַעֲשֶׂה־חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
14.en: With God we shall triumph;He will trample our foes.

1.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
1.en: For the leader. Of David. A psalm.O God of my praise,do not keep aloof,

2.he: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
2.en: for the wicked and the deceitfulopen their mouth against me;they speak to me with lying tongue.

3.he: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
3.en: They encircle me with words of hate;they attack me without cause.

4.he: תַּֽחַת־אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃
4.en: They answer my love with accusationand I must stand judgment.

5.he: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
5.en: They repay me with evil for good,with hatred for my love.

6.he: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־יְמִינֽוֹ׃
6.en: Appoint a wicked man over him;may an accuser stand at his right side;

7.he: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לַחֲטָאָֽה׃
7.en: may he be tried and convicted;may he be judged and found guilty.

8.he: יִֽהְיוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃
8.en: May his days be few;may another take over his position.

9.he: יִֽהְיוּ־בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
9.en: May his children be orphans,his wife a widow.

10.he: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחׇרְבֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
10.en: May his children wander from their hovels,begging in search of [bread].

11.he: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃
11.en: May his creditor seize all his possessions;may strangers plunder his wealth.

12.he: אַל־יְהִי־ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִֽיתוֹמָֽיו׃
12.en: May no one show him mercy;may none pity his orphans;

13.he: יְהִֽי־אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃
13.en: may his posterity be cut off;may their names be blotted out in the next generation.

14.he: יִזָּכֵ֤ר׀ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־תִּמָּֽח׃
14.en: May God be ever mindful of his father’s iniquity,and may the sin of his mother not be blotted out.

15.he: יִהְי֣וּ נֶגֶד־יְהֹוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
15.en: May the LORD be aware of them alwaysand cause their names to be cut off from the earth,

16.he: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֢וֹת חָ֥֫סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃
16.en: because he was not minded to act kindly,and hounded to death the poor and needy man,one crushed in spirit.

17.he: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא־חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
17.en: He loved to curse—may a curse come upon him!He would not bless—may blessing be far from him!

18.he: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃
18.en: May he be clothed in a curse like a garment,may it enter his body like water,his bones like oil.

19.he: תְּהִי־ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃
19.en: Let it be like the cloak he wraps around him,like the belt he always wears.

20.he: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃
20.en: May the LORD thus repay my accusers,all those who speak evil against me.

21.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה׀ יֱ֘הֹוִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה־אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
21.en: Now You, O God, my Lord,act on my behalf as befits Your name.Good and faithful as You are, save me.

22.he: כִּי־עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
22.en: For I am poor and needy,and my heart is pierced within me.

23.he: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּאַרְבֶּֽה׃
23.en: I fade away like a lengthening shadow;I am shaken off like locusts.

24.he: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
24.en: My knees give way from fasting;my flesh is lean, has lost its fat.

25.he: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
25.en: I am the object of their scorn;when they see me, they shake their head.

26.he: עׇ֭זְרֵנִי יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
26.en: Help me, O LORD, my God;save me in accord with Your faithfulness,

27.he: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃
27.en: that men may know that it is Your hand,that You, O LORD, have done it.

28.he: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֢ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ׀ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
28.en: Let them curse, but You bless;let them rise up, but come to grief,while Your servant rejoices.

29.he: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בׇּשְׁתָּֽם׃
29.en: My accusers shall be clothed in shame,wrapped in their disgrace as in a robe.

30.he: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהֹוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַלְלֶֽנּוּ׃
30.en: My mouth shall sing much praise to the LORD;I will acclaim Him in the midst of a throng,

31.he: כִּֽי־יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ {פ}
31.en: because He stands at the right hand of the needy,to save him from those who would condemn him.

1.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהֹוָ֨ה׀ לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃
1.en: Of David. A psalm.The LORD said to my lord,“Sit at My right handwhile I make your enemies your footstool.”

2.he: מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הֹוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
2.en: The LORD will stretch forth from Zion your mighty scepter;hold sway over your enemies!

3.he: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֢וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃
3.en: Your people come forward willingly on your day of battle.In majestic holiness, from the womb,from the dawn, yours was the dew of youth.

4.he: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהֹוָ֨ה׀ וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃
4.en: The LORD has sworn and will not relent,“You are a priest forever, a rightful king by My decree.”

5.he: אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל־יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּיוֹם־אַפּ֣וֹ מְלָכִֽים׃
5.en: The Lord is at your right hand.He crushes kings in the day of His anger.

6.he: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃
6.en: He works judgment upon the nations,heaping up bodies,crushing heads far and wide.

7.he: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃ {פ}
7.en: He drinks from the stream on his way;therefore he holds his head high.

1.he: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ׀ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה בְּכׇל־לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃
1.en: Hallelujah.I praise the LORD with all my heartin the assembled congregation of the upright.

2.he: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכׇל־חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם׃
2.en: The works of the LORD are great,within reach of all who desire them.

3.he: הוֹד־וְהָדָ֥ר פׇּעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
3.en: His deeds are splendid and glorious;His beneficence is everlasting;

4.he: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהֹוָֽה׃
4.en: He has won renown for His wonders.The LORD is gracious and compassionate;

5.he: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
5.en: He gives food to those who fear Him;He is ever mindful of His covenant.

6.he: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם׃
6.en: He revealed to His people His powerful works,in giving them the heritage of nations.

7.he: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כׇּל־פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃
7.en: His handiwork is truth and justice;all His precepts are enduring,

8.he: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃
8.en: well-founded for all eternity,wrought of truth and equity.

9.he: פְּד֤וּת׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ׃
9.en: He sent redemption to His people;He ordained His covenant for all time;His name is holy and awesome.

10.he: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חׇכְמָ֨ה׀ יִרְאַ֬ת יְהֹוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכׇל־עֹֽשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃ {פ}
10.en: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD;all who practice it gain sound understanding.Praise of Him is everlasting.

1.he: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃
1.en: Hallelujah.Happy is the man who fears the LORD,who is ardently devoted to His commandments.

2.he: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֖וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
2.en: His descendants will be mighty in the land,a blessed generation of upright men.

3.he: הוֹן־וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
3.en: Wealth and riches are in his house,and his beneficence lasts forever.

4.he: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
4.en: A light shines for the upright in the darkness;he is gracious, compassionate, and beneficent.

5.he: טֽוֹב־אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
5.en: All goes well with the man who lends generously,who conducts his affairs with equity.

6.he: כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹֽא־יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃
6.en: He shall never be shaken;the beneficent man will be remembered forever.

7.he: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
7.en: He is not afraid of evil tidings;his heart is firm, he trusts in the LORD.

8.he: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃
8.en: His heart is resolute, he is unafraid;in the end he will see the fall of his foes.

9.he: פִּזַּ֤ר׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃
9.en: He gives freely to the poor;his beneficence lasts forever;his horn is exalted in honor.

10.he: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃ {פ}
10.en: The wicked man shall see it and be vexed;he shall gnash his teeth; his courage shall fail.The desire of the wicked shall come to nothing.

1.he: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
1.en: Hallelujah.O servants of the LORD, give praise;praise the name of the LORD.

2.he: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
2.en: Let the name of the LORD be blessednow and forever.

3.he: מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
3.en: From east to westthe name of the LORD is praised.

4.he: רָ֖ם עַל־כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם׀יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
4.en: The LORD is exalted above all nations;His glory is above the heavens.

5.he: מִ֭י כַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הַֽמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
5.en: Who is like the LORD our God,who, enthroned on high,

6.he: הַֽמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ׃
6.en: sees what is below,in heaven and on earth?

7.he: מְקִ֥ימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
7.en: He raises the poor from the dust,lifts up the needy from the refuse heap

8.he: לְהוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם־נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃
8.en: to set them with the great,with the great men of His people.

9.he: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י׀ עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
9.en: He sets the childless woman among her householdas a happy mother of children.Hallelujah.

1.he: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃
1.en: When Israel went forth from Egypt,the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,

2.he: הָיְתָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֣ה לְקׇדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָֽיו׃
2.en: Judah became His holy one,Israel, His dominion.

3.he: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
3.en: The sea saw them and fled,Jordan ran backward,

4.he: הֶ֭הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹֽאן׃
4.en: mountains skipped like rams,hills like sheep.

5.he: מַה־לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
5.en: What alarmed you, O sea, that you fled,Jordan, that you ran backward,

6.he: הֶ֭הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹֽאן׃
6.en: mountains, that you skipped like rams,hills, like sheep?

7.he: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
7.en: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord,at the presence of the God of Jacob,

8.he: הַהֹפְכִ֣י הַצּ֣וּר אֲגַם־מָ֑יִם חַ֝לָּמִ֗ישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָֽיִם׃
8.en: who turned the rock into a pool of water,the flinty rock into a fountain.

1.he: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹ֫א־לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
1.en: Not to us, O LORD, not to usbut to Your name bring gloryfor the sake of Your love and Your faithfulness.

2.he: לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה־נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
2.en: Let the nations not say,“Where, now, is their God?”

3.he: וֵאלֹהֵ֥ינוּ בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵ֣ץ עָשָֽׂה׃
3.en: when our God is in heavenand all that He wills He accomplishes.

4.he: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
4.en: Their idols are silver and gold,the work of men’s hands.

5.he: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃
5.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak,eyes, but cannot see;

6.he: אׇזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃
6.en: they have ears, but cannot hear,noses, but cannot smell;

7.he: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם׀ וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹא־יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃
7.en: they have hands, but cannot touch,feet, but cannot walk;they can make no sound in their throats.

8.he: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃
8.en: Those who fashion them,all who trust in them,shall become like them.

9.he: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
9.en: O Israel, trust in the LORD!He is their help and shield.

10.he: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
10.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD!He is their help and shield.

11.he: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
11.en: O you who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD!He is their help and shield.

12.he: יְהֹוָה֮ זְכָרָ֢נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃
12.en: The LORD is mindful of us.He will bless us;He will bless the house of Israel;He will bless the house of Aaron;

13.he: יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַ֝קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִֽים׃
13.en: He will bless those who fear the LORD,small and great alike.

14.he: יֹסֵ֣ף יְהֹוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
14.en: May the LORD increase your numbers,yours and your children’s also.

15.he: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
15.en: May you be blessed by the LORD,Maker of heaven and earth.

16.he: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃
16.en: The heavens belong to the LORD,but the earth He gave over to man.

17.he: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ־יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כׇּל־יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃
17.en: The dead cannot praise the LORD,nor any who go down into silence.

18.he: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ׀ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד־עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
18.en: But we will bless the LORDnow and forever.Hallelujah.

1.he: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶת־ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
1.en: I love the LORDfor He hears my voice, my pleas;

2.he: כִּי־הִטָּ֣ה אׇזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃
2.en: for He turns His ear to mewhenever I call.

3.he: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי׀ חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
3.en: The bonds of death encompassed me;the torments of Sheol overtook me.I came upon trouble and sorrow

4.he: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
4.en: and I invoked the name of the LORD,“O LORD, save my life!”

5.he: חַנּ֣וּן יְהֹוָ֣ה וְצַדִּ֑יק וֵ֖אלֹהֵ֣ינוּ מְרַחֵֽם׃
5.en: The LORD is gracious and beneficent;our God is compassionate.

6.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
6.en: The LORD protects the simple;I was brought low and He saved me.

7.he: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
7.en: Be at rest, once again, O my soul,for the LORD has been good to you.

8.he: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
8.en: You have delivered me from death,my eyes from tears,my feet from stumbling.

9.he: אֶ֭תְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּ֝אַרְצ֗וֹת הַחַיִּֽים׃
9.en: I shall walk before the LORDin the lands of the living.

10.he: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
10.en: I trust [in the LORD];out of great suffering I spoke

11.he: אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְחׇפְזִ֑י כׇּֽל־הָאָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב׃
11.en: and said rashly,“All men are false.”

12.he: מָה־אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהֹוָ֑ה כׇּֽל־תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי׃
12.en: How can I repay the LORDfor all His bounties to me?

13.he: כּוֹס־יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
13.en: I raise the cup of deliveranceand invoke the name of the LORD.

14.he: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־נָּ֝֗א לְכׇל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
14.en: I will pay my vows to the LORDin the presence of all His people.

15.he: יָ֭קָר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַ֝מָּ֗וְתָה לַחֲסִידָֽיו׃
15.en: The death of His faithful onesis grievous in the LORD’s sight.

16.he: אָנָּ֣ה יְהֹוָה֮ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֢י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמֽוֹסֵרָֽי׃
16.en: O LORD,I am Your servant,Your servant, the son of Your maidservant;You have undone the cords that bound me.

17.he: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
17.en: I will sacrifice a thank offering to Youand invoke the name of the LORD.

18.he: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־נָּ֝֗א לְכׇל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
18.en: I will pay my vows to the LORDin the presence of all His people,

19.he: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
19.en: in the courts of the house of the LORD,in the midst of Jerusalem.Hallelujah.

1.he: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כׇּל־הָאֻמִּֽים׃
1.en: Praise the LORD, all you nations;extol Him, all you peoples,

2.he: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ׀ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
2.en: for great is His steadfast love toward us;the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.Hallelujah.

1.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
1.en: Praise the LORD, for He is good,His steadfast love is eternal.

2.he: יֹאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
2.en: Let Israel declare,“His steadfast love is eternal.”

3.he: יֹאמְרוּ־נָ֥א בֵֽית־אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
3.en: Let the house of Aaron declare,“His steadfast love is eternal.”

4.he: יֹאמְרוּ־נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
4.en: Let those who fear the LORD declare,“His steadfast love is eternal.”

5.he: מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃
5.en: In distress I called on the LORD;the Lord answered me and brought me relief.

6.he: יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃
6.en: The LORD is on my side,I have no fear;what can man do to me?

7.he: יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃
7.en: With the LORD on my side as my helper,I will see the downfall of my foes.

8.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃
8.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORDthan to trust in mortals;

9.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃
9.en: it is better to take refuge in the LORDthan to trust in the great.

10.he: כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
10.en: All nations have beset me;by the name of the LORD I will surely cut them down.

11.he: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
11.en: They beset me, they surround me;by the name of the LORD I will surely cut them down.

12.he: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
12.en: They have beset me like bees;they shall be extinguished like burning thorns;by the name of the LORD I will surely cut them down.

13.he: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהֹוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃
13.en: You pressed me hard,I nearly fell;but the LORD helped me.

14.he: עׇזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִישׁוּעָֽה׃
14.en: The LORD is my strength and might;He has become my deliverance.

15.he: ק֤וֹל׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאׇהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
15.en: The tents of the victorious resound with joyous shouts of deliverance,“The right hand of the LORD is triumphant!

16.he: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הֹוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
16.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted!The right hand of the LORD is triumphant!”

17.he: לֹא־אָמ֥וּת כִּֽי־אֶחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃
17.en: I shall not die but liveand proclaim the works of the LORD.

18.he: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃
18.en: The LORD punished me severely,but did not hand me over to death.

19.he: פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָבֹא־בָ֝֗ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃
19.en: Open the gates of victory for methat I may enter them and praise the LORD.

20.he: זֶה־הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהֹוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃
20.en: This is the gateway to the LORD—the victorious shall enter through it.

21.he: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִישׁוּעָֽה׃
21.en: I praise You, for You have answered me,and have become my deliverance.

22.he: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃
22.en: The stone that the builders rejectedhas become the chief cornerstone.

23.he: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
23.en: This is the LORD’s doing;it is marvelous in our sight.

24.he: זֶה־הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהֹוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
24.en: This is the day that the LORD has made—let us exult and rejoice on it.

25.he: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃
25.en: O LORD, deliver us!O LORD, let us prosper!

26.he: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַ֥כְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
26.en: May he who enters be blessed in the name of the LORD;we bless you from the House of the LORD.

27.he: אֵ֤ל׀ יְהֹוָה֮ וַיָּ֢אֶ֫ר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
27.en: The LORD is God;He has given us light;bind the festal offering to the horns of the altar with cords.

28.he: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃
28.en: You are my God and I will praise You;You are my God and I will extol You.

29.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
29.en: Praise the LORD for He is good,His steadfast love is eternal.

1.he: אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ הַ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
1.en: Happy are those whose way is blameless,who follow the teaching of the LORD.

2.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכׇל־לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃
2.en: Happy are those who observe His decrees,who turn to Him wholeheartedly.

3.he: אַ֭ף לֹא־פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ׃
3.en: They have done no wrong,but have followed His ways.

4.he: אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד׃
4.en: You have commanded that Your preceptsbe kept diligently.

5.he: אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
5.en: Would that my ways were firmin keeping Your laws;

6.he: אָ֥ז לֹא־אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
6.en: then I would not be ashamedwhen I regard all Your commandments.

7.he: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לׇמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
7.en: I will praise You with a sincere heartas I learn Your just rules.

8.he: אֶת־חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
8.en: I will keep Your laws;do not utterly forsake me.

9.he: בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה־נַּ֭עַר אֶת־אׇרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
9.en: How can a young man keep his way pure?—by holding to Your word.

10.he: בְּכׇל־לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל־תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
10.en: I have turned to You with all my heart;do not let me stray from Your commandments.

11.he: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃
11.en: In my heart I treasure Your promise;therefore I do not sin against You.

12.he: בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
12.en: Blessed are You, O LORD;train me in Your laws.

13.he: בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
13.en: With my lips I rehearseall the rules You proclaimed.

14.he: בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַּׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כׇּל־הֽוֹן׃
14.en: I rejoice over the way of Your decreesas over all riches.

15.he: בְּפִקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
15.en: I study Your precepts;I regard Your ways;

16.en: I take delight in Your laws;I will not neglect Your word.

17.he: גְּמֹ֖ל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ׃
17.en: Deal kindly with Your servant,that I may live to keep Your word.

18.he: גַּל־עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
18.en: Open my eyes, that I may perceivethe wonders of Your teaching.

19.he: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
19.en: I am only a sojourner in the land;do not hide Your commandments from me.

20.he: גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל־מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכׇל־עֵֽת׃
20.en: My soul is consumed with longingfor Your rules at all times.

21.he: גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִ֗ים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
21.en: You blast the accursed insolent oneswho stray from Your commandments.

22.he: גַּ֣ל מֵ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
22.en: Take away from me taunt and abuse,because I observe Your decrees.

23.he: גַּ֤ם יָשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
23.en: Though princes meet and speak against me,Your servant studies Your laws.

24.he: גַּֽם־עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי׃ {פ}
24.en: For Your decrees are my delight,my intimate companions.

25.he: דָּבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
25.en: My soul clings to the dust;revive me in accordance with Your word.

26.he: דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
26.en: I have declared my way, and You have answered me;train me in Your laws.

27.he: דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
27.en: Make me understand the way of Your precepts,that I may study Your wondrous acts.

28.he: דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
28.en: I am racked with grief;sustain me in accordance with Your word.

29.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ־שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חׇנֵּֽנִי׃
29.en: Remove all false ways from me;favor me with Your teaching.

30.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי׃
30.en: I have chosen the way of faithfulness;I have set Your rules before me.

31.he: דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַל־תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי׃
31.en: I cling to Your decrees;O LORD, do not put me to shame.

32.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי׃ {פ}
32.en: I eagerly pursue Your commandments,for You broaden my understanding.

33.he: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃
33.en: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your laws;I will observe them to the utmost.

34.he: הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶ֥נָּה בְכׇל־לֵֽב׃
34.en: Give me understanding, that I may observe Your teachingand keep it wholeheartedly.

35.he: הַ֭דְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ כִּי־ב֥וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי׃
35.en: Lead me in the path of Your commandments,for that is my concern.

36.he: הַט־לִ֭בִּי אֶל־עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ וְאַ֣ל אֶל־בָּֽצַע׃
36.en: Turn my heart to Your decreesand not to love of gain.

37.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
37.en: Avert my eyes from seeing falsehood;by Your ways preserve me.

38.he: הָקֵ֣ם לְ֭עַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לְיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
38.en: Fulfill Your promise to Your servant,which is for those who worship You.

39.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃
39.en: Remove the taunt that I dread,for Your rules are good.

40.he: הִ֭נֵּה תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶ֑יךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃ {פ}
40.en: See, I have longed for Your precepts;by Your righteousness preserve me.

41.he: וִיבֹאֻ֣נִי חֲסָדֶ֣ךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה תְּ֝שׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
41.en: May Your steadfast love reach me, O LORD,Your deliverance, as You have promised.

42.he: וְאֶעֱנֶ֣ה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָ֑ר כִּֽי־בָ֝טַ֗חְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
42.en: I shall have an answer for those who taunt me,for I have put my trust in Your word.

43.he: וְֽאַל־תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
43.en: Do not utterly take the truth away from my mouth,for I have put my hope in Your rules.

44.he: וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֖ה תוֹרָתְךָ֥ תָמִ֗יד לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
44.en: I will always obey Your teaching,forever and ever.

45.he: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָ֥ה בָרְחָבָ֑ה כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי׃
45.en: I will walk about at ease,for I have turned to Your precepts.

46.he: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
46.en: I will speak of Your decrees,and not be ashamed in the presence of kings.

47.he: וְאֶשְׁתַּעֲשַׁ֥ע בְּמִצְוֺתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהָֽבְתִּי׃
47.en: I will delight in Your commandments,which I love.

48.he: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃ {פ}
48.en: I reach out for Your commandments, which I love;I study Your laws.

49.he: זְכֹר־דָּבָ֥ר לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ עַ֝֗ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽחַלְתָּֽנִי׃
49.en: Remember Your word to Your servantthrough which You have given me hope.

50.he: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעׇנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃
50.en: This is my comfort in my affliction,that Your promise has preserved me.

51.he: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּ֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
51.en: Though the arrogant have cruelly mocked me,I have not swerved from Your teaching.

52.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ מֵעוֹלָ֥ם׀יְהֹוָ֗ה וָאֶתְנֶחָֽם׃
52.en: I remember Your rules of old, O LORD,and find comfort in them.

53.he: זַלְעָפָ֣ה אֲ֭חָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים עֹ֝זְבֵ֗י תּֽוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
53.en: I am seized with ragebecause of the wicked who forsake Your teaching.

54.he: זְ֭מִרוֹת הָיוּ־לִ֥י חֻקֶּ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית מְגוּרָֽי׃
54.en: Your laws are a source of strength to mewherever I may dwell.

55.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה וָ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּֽוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
55.en: I remember Your name at night, O LORD,and obey Your teaching.

56.he: זֹ֥את הָיְתָה־לִּ֑י כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃ {פ}
56.en: This has been my lot,for I have observed Your precepts.

57.en: The LORD is my portion;I have resolved to keep Your words.

58.en: I have implored You with all my heart;have mercy on me, in accordance with Your promise.

59.en: I have considered my ways,and have turned back to Your decrees.

60.en: I have hurried and not delayedto keep Your commandments.

61.he: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּ֥֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
61.en: Though the bonds of the wicked are coiled round me,I have not neglected Your teaching.

62.he: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
62.en: I arise at midnight to praise Youfor Your just rules.

63.he: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
63.en: I am a companion to all who fear You,to those who keep Your precepts.

64.he: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ {פ}
64.en: Your steadfast love, O LORD, fills the earth;teach me Your laws.

65.en: You have treated Your servant well,according to Your word, O LORD.

66.he: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃
66.en: Teach me good sense and knowledge,for I have put my trust in Your commandments.

67.he: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃
67.en: Before I was humbled I went astray,but now I keep Your word.

68.en: You are good and beneficent;teach me Your laws.

69.he: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכׇל־לֵ֤ב׀ אֶצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
69.en: Though the arrogant have accused me falsely,I observe Your precepts wholeheartedly.

70.he: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃
70.en: Their minds are thick like fat;as for me, Your teaching is my delight.

71.en: It was good for me that I was humbled,so that I might learn Your laws.

72.en: I prefer the teaching You proclaimedto thousands of gold and silver pieces.

73.he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
73.en: Your hands made me and fashioned me;give me understanding that I may learn Your commandments.

74.he: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
74.en: Those who fear You will see me and rejoice,for I have put my hope in Your word.

75.he: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הֹוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃
75.en: I know, O LORD, that Your rulings are just;rightly have You humbled me.

76.en: May Your steadfast love comfort mein accordance with Your promise to Your servant.

77.en: May Your mercy reach me, that I might live,for Your teaching is my delight.

78.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
78.en: Let the insolent be dismayed, for they have wronged me without cause;I will study Your precepts.

79.en: May those who fear You,those who know Your decrees,turn again to me.

80.he: יְהִי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃ {פ}
80.en: May I wholeheartedly follow Your lawsso that I do not come to grief.

81.en: I long for Your deliverance;I hope for Your word.

82.he: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
82.en: My eyes pine away for Your promise;I say, “When will You comfort me?”

83.he: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
83.en: Though I have become like a water-skin dried in smoke,I have not neglected Your laws.

84.he: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
84.en: How long has Your servant to live?when will You bring my persecutors to judgment?

85.he: כָּרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
85.en: The insolent have dug pits for me,flouting Your teaching.

86.en: All Your commandments are enduring;I am persecuted without cause; help me!

87.he: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּדֶֽיךָ׃
87.en: Though they almost wiped me off the earth,I did not abandon Your precepts.

88.en: As befits Your steadfast love, preserve me,so that I may keep the decree You proclaimed.

89.en: The LORD exists forever;Your word stands firm in heaven.

90.he: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּֽ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃
90.en: Your faithfulness is for all generations;You have established the earth, and it stands.

91.he: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
91.en: They stand this day to [carry out] Your rulings,for all are Your servants.

92.he: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעׇנְיִֽי׃
92.en: Were not Your teaching my delightI would have perished in my affliction.

93.he: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃
93.en: I will never neglect Your precepts,for You have preserved my life through them.

94.en: I am Yours; save me!For I have turned to Your precepts.

95.he: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
95.en: The wicked hope to destroy me,but I ponder Your decrees.

96.he: לְֽכׇל־תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
96.en: I have seen that all things have their limit,but Your commandment is broad beyond measure.

97.en: O how I love Your teaching!It is my study all day long.

98.he: מֵֽ֭אֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־לִֽי׃
98.en: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies;they always stand by me.

99.he: מִכׇּל־מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽי׃
99.en: I have gained more insight than all my teachers,for Your decrees are my study.

100.en: I have gained more understanding than my elders,for I observe Your precepts.

101.he: מִכׇּל־אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
101.en: I have avoided every evil wayso that I may keep Your word.

102.en: I have not departed from Your rules,for You have instructed me.

103.en: How pleasing is Your word to my palate,sweeter than honey.

104.he: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי׀ כׇּל־אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃ {פ}
104.en: I ponder Your precepts;therefore I hate every false way.

105.en: Your word is a lamp to my feet,a light for my path.

106.en: I have firmly swornto keep Your just rules.

107.en: I am very much afflicted;O LORD, preserve me in accordance with Your word.

108.he: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
108.en: Accept, O LORD, my freewill offerings;teach me Your rules.

109.he: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
109.en: Though my life is always in danger,I do not neglect Your teaching.

110.he: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃
110.en: Though the wicked have set a trap for me,I have not strayed from Your precepts.

111.he: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃
111.en: Your decrees are my eternal heritage;they are my heart’s delight.

112.he: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃ {פ}
112.en: I am resolved to follow Your lawsto the utmost forever.

113.en: I hate men of divided heart,but I love Your teaching.

114.en: You are my protection and my shield;I hope for Your word.

115.en: Keep away from me, you evildoers,that I may observe the commandments of my God.

116.en: Support me as You promised, so that I may live;do not thwart my expectation.

117.en: Sustain me that I may be saved,and I will always muse upon Your laws.

118.en: You reject all who stray from Your laws,for they are false and deceitful.

119.he: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כׇל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
119.en: You do away with the wicked as if they were dross;rightly do I love Your decrees.

120.en: My flesh creeps from fear of You;I am in awe of Your rulings.

121.en: I have done what is just and right;do not abandon me to those who would wrong me.

122.en: Guarantee Your servant’s well-being;do not let the arrogant wrong me.

123.en: My eyes pine away for Your deliverance,for Your promise of victory.

124.en: Deal with Your servant as befits Your steadfast love;teach me Your laws.

125.en: I am Your servant;give me understanding,that I might know Your decrees.

126.en: It is a time to act for the LORD,for they have violated Your teaching.

127.en: Rightly do I love Your commandmentsmore than gold, even fine gold.

128.he: עַל־כֵּ֤ן׀ כׇּל־פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כׇּל־אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃ {פ}
128.en: Truly by all [Your] precepts I walk straight;I hate every false way.

129.en: Your decrees are wondrous;rightly do I observe them.

130.en: The words You inscribed give light,and grant understanding to the simple.

131.en: I open my mouth wide, I pant,longing for Your commandments.

132.en: Turn to me and be gracious to me,as is Your rule with those who love Your name.

133.en: Make my feet firm through Your promise;do not let iniquity dominate me.

134.en: Redeem me from being wronged by man,that I may keep Your precepts.

135.en: Show favor to Your servant,and teach me Your laws.

136.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־שָׁמְר֥וּ תֽוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
136.en: My eyes shed streams of waterbecause men do not obey Your teaching.

137.en: You are righteous, O LORD;Your rulings are just.

138.en: You have ordained righteous decrees;they are firmly enduring.

139.en: I am consumed with rageover my foes’ neglect of Your words.

140.en: Your word is exceedingly pure,and Your servant loves it.

141.he: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
141.en: Though I am belittled and despised,I have not neglected Your precepts.

142.en: Your righteousness is eternal;Your teaching is true.

143.en: Though anguish and distress come upon me,Your commandments are my delight.

144.en: Your righteous decrees are eternal;give me understanding, that I might live.

145.he: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכׇל־לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃
145.en: I call with all my heart;answer me, O LORD,that I may observe Your laws.

146.en: I call upon You; save me,that I may keep Your decrees.

147.en: I rise before dawn and cry for help;I hope for Your word.

148.en: My eyes greet each watch of the night,as I meditate on Your promise.

149.he: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
149.en: Hear my voice as befits Your steadfast love;O LORD, preserve me, as is Your rule.

150.en: Those who pursue intrigue draw near;they are far from Your teaching.

151.en: You, O LORD, are near,and all Your commandments are true.

152.he: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃ {פ}
152.en: I know from Your decrees of oldthat You have established them forever.

153.en: See my affliction and rescue me,for I have not neglected Your teaching.

154.en: Champion my cause and redeem me;preserve me according to Your promise.

155.he: רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
155.en: Deliverance is far from the wicked,for they have not turned to Your laws.

156.en: Your mercies are great, O LORD;as is Your rule, preserve me.

157.he: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
157.en: Many are my persecutors and foes;I have not swerved from Your decrees.

158.he: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
158.en: I have seen traitors and loathed them,because they did not keep Your word in mind.

159.he: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
159.en: See that I have loved Your precepts;O LORD, preserve me, as befits Your steadfast love.

160.en: Truth is the essence of Your word;Your just rules are eternal.

161.en: Princes have persecuted me without reason;my heart thrills at Your word.

162.he: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃
162.en: I rejoice over Your promiseas one who obtains great spoil.

163.en: I hate and abhor falsehood;I love Your teaching.

164.he: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
164.en: I praise You seven times each dayfor Your just rules.

165.he: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃
165.en: Those who love Your teaching enjoy well-being;they encounter no adversity.

166.en: I hope for Your deliverance, O LORD;I observe Your commandments.

167.en: I obey Your decreesand love them greatly.

168.he: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כׇל־דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
168.en: I obey Your precepts and decrees;all my ways are before You.

169.he: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃
169.en: May my plea reach You, O LORD;grant me understanding according to Your word.

170.en: May my petition come before You;save me in accordance with Your promise.

171.he: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
171.en: My lips shall pour forth praise,for You teach me Your laws.

172.he: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כׇל־מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃
172.en: My tongue shall declare Your promise,for all Your commandments are just.

173.en: Lend Your hand to help me,for I have chosen Your precepts.

174.en: I have longed for Your deliverance, O LORD;Your teaching is my delight.

175.en: Let me live, that I may praise You;may Your rules be my help;

176.he: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃ {פ}
176.en: I have strayed like a lost sheep;search for Your servant,for I have not neglected Your commandments.

1.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצָּרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃
1.en: A song of ascents.In my distress I called to the LORDand He answered me.

2.he: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁ֑קֶר מִלָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
2.en: O LORD, save me from treacherous lips,from a deceitful tongue!

3.he: מַה־יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
3.en: What can you profit,what can you gain,O deceitful tongue?

4.he: חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים׃
4.en: A warrior’s sharp arrows,with hot coals of broom-wood.

5.he: אֽוֹיָה־לִ֭י כִּי־גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם־אׇהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר׃
5.en: Woe is me, that I live with Meshech,that I dwell among the clans of Kedar.

6.he: רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה־לָּ֣הּ נַפְשִׁ֑י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם׃
6.en: Too long have I dwelt with those who hate peace.

7.he: אֲֽנִי־שָׁ֭לוֹם וְכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר הֵ֝֗מָּה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ {פ}
7.en: I am all peace;but when I speak,they are for war.

1.he: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃
1.en: A song for ascents.I turn my eyes to the mountains;from where will my help come?

2.he: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
2.en: My help comes from the LORD,maker of heaven and earth.

3.he: אַל־יִתֵּ֣ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑ךָ אַל־יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹׁמְרֶֽךָ׃
3.en: He will not let your foot give way;your guardian will not slumber;

4.he: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
4.en: See, the guardian of Israelneither slumbers nor sleeps!

5.he: יְהֹוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
5.en: The LORD is your guardian,the LORD is your protectionat your right hand.

6.he: יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא־יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
6.en: By day the sun will not strike you,nor the moon by night.

7.he: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁמׇרְךָ֥ מִכׇּל־רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
7.en: The LORD will guard you from all harm;He will guard your life.

8.he: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁמׇר־צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
8.en: The LORD will guard your going and comingnow and forever.

1.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃
1.en: A song of ascents. Of David. I rejoiced when they said to me,“We are going to the House of the LORD.”

2.he: עֹ֭מְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑ינוּ בִּ֝שְׁעָרַ֗יִךְ יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
2.en: Our feet stood inside your gates, O Jerusalem,

3.he: יְרוּשָׁלַ֥͏ִם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
3.en: Jerusalem built up, a city knit together,

4.he: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
4.en: to which tribes would make pilgrimage,the tribes of the LORD,—as was enjoined upon Israel—to praise the name of the LORD.

5.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה׀ יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽד׃
5.en: There the thrones of judgment stood,thrones of the house of David.

6.he: שַׁ֭אֲלוּ שְׁל֣וֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם יִ֝שְׁלָ֗יוּ אֹהֲבָֽיִךְ׃
6.en: Pray for the well-being of Jerusalem;“May those who love you be at peace.

7.he: יְהִי־שָׁל֥וֹם בְּחֵילֵ֑ךְ שַׁ֝לְוָ֗ה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
7.en: May there be well-being within your ramparts,peace in your citadels.”

8.he: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃
8.en: For the sake of my kin and friends,I pray for your well-being;

9.he: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃ {פ}
9.en: for the sake of the house of the LORD our God,I seek your good.

1.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
1.en: A song of ascents.To You, enthroned in heaven,I turn my eyes.

2.he: הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל־יַ֤ד אֲֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל־יַ֢ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחׇנֵּֽנוּ׃
2.en: As the eyes of slaves follow their master’s hand,as the eyes of a slave-girl follow the hand of her mistress,so our eyes are toward the LORD our God,awaiting His favor.

3.he: חׇנֵּ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה חׇנֵּ֑נוּ כִּי־רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃
3.en: Show us favor, O LORD,show us favor!We have had more than enough of contempt.

4.he: רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה־לָּ֢הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּֽׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז (לגאיונים) [לִגְאֵ֥י יוֹנִֽים]׃ {פ}
4.en: Long enough have we enduredthe scorn of the complacent,the contempt of the haughty.

1.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹאמַר־נָ֝֗א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
1.en: A song of ascents. Of David.Were it not for the LORD, who was on our side,let Israel now declare,

2.he: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃
2.en: were it not for the LORD, who was on our sidewhen men assailed us,

3.he: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃
3.en: they would have swallowed us alivein their burning rage against us;

4.he: אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֝֗חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃
4.en: the waters would have carried us off,the torrent would have swept over us;

5.he: אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל־נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ הַ֝מַּ֗יִם הַזֵּידוֹנִֽים׃
5.en: over us would have sweptthe seething waters.

6.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃
6.en: Blessed is the LORD, who did not let usbe ripped apart by their teeth.

7.he: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֢ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃
7.en: We are like a bird escaped from the fowler’s trap;the trap broke and we escaped.

8.he: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
8.en: Our help is the name of the LORD,maker of heaven and earth.

1.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהֹוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא־יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְעוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃
1.en: A song of ascents.Those who trust in the LORDare like Mount Zionthat cannot be moved,enduring forever.

2.he: יְֽרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֢יב לָ֥֫הּ וַ֭יהֹוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמּ֑וֹ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
2.en: Jerusalem, hills enfold it,and the LORD enfolds His peoplenow and forever.

3.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֢ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
3.en: The scepter of the wicked shall never restupon the land allotted to the righteous,that the righteous not set their hand to wrongdoing.

4.he: הֵיטִ֣יבָה יְ֭הֹוָה לַטּוֹבִ֑ים וְ֝לִישָׁרִ֗ים בְּלִבּוֹתָֽם׃
4.en: Do good, O LORD, to the good,to the upright in heart.

5.he: וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עֲֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
5.en: But those who in their crookedness act corruptly,let the LORD make them go the way of evildoers.May it be well with Israel!

1.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃
1.en: A song of ascents.When the LORD restores the fortunes of Zion—we see it as in a dream—

2.he: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֢נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃
2.en: our mouths shall be filled with laughter,our tongues, with songs of joy.Then shall they say among the nations,“The LORD has done great things for them!”

3.he: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הֹוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃
3.en: The LORD will do great things for usand we shall rejoice.

4.he: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־[שְׁבִיתֵ֑נוּ] (שבותנו) כַּאֲפִיקִ֥ים בַּנֶּֽגֶב׃
4.en: Restore our fortunes, O LORD,like watercourses in the Negeb.

5.he: הַזֹּרְעִ֥ים בְּדִמְעָ֗ה בְּרִנָּ֥ה יִקְצֹֽרוּ׃
5.en: They who sow in tearsshall reap with songs of joy.

6.he: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ׀ וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֢א מֶשֶׁךְ־הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּא־יָבֹ֥א בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃ {פ}
6.en: Though he goes along weeping,carrying the seed-bag,he shall come back with songs of joy,carrying his sheaves.

1.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לִשְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם־יְהֹוָ֤ה׀ לֹא־יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣יו בּ֑וֹ אִם־יְהֹוָ֥ה לֹא־יִשְׁמׇר־עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא׀ שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר׃
1.en: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.Unless the LORD builds the house,its builders labor in vain on it;unless the LORD watches over the city,the watchman keeps vigil in vain.

2.he: שָׁ֤וְא לָכֶ֨ם מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵֽי ק֡וּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָעֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִידִיד֣וֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃
2.en: In vain do you rise earlyand stay up late,you who toil for the bread you eat;He provides as much for His loved ones while they sleep.

3.he: הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַבָּֽטֶן׃
3.en: Sons are the provision of the LORD;the fruit of the womb, His reward.

4.he: כְּחִצִּ֥ים בְּיַד־גִּבּ֑וֹר כֵּ֝֗ן בְּנֵ֣י הַנְּעוּרִֽים׃
4.en: Like arrows in the hand of a warriorare sons born to a man in his youth.

5.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־אַשְׁפָּת֗וֹ מֵ֫הֶ֥ם לֹֽא־יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃ {פ}
5.en: Happy is the man who fills his quiver with them;they shall not be put to shamewhen they contend with the enemy in the gate.

1.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כׇּל־יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
1.en: A song of ascents.Happy are all who fear the LORD,who follow His ways.

2.he: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
2.en: You shall enjoy the fruit of your labors;you shall be happy and you shall prosper.

3.he: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤׀ כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֢י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃
3.en: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house;your sons, like olive saplings around your table.

4.he: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָֽה׃
4.en: So shall the man who fears the LORD be blessed.

5.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֗ה מִצִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
5.en: May the LORD bless you from Zion;may you share the prosperity of Jerusalemall the days of your life,

6.he: וּרְאֵֽה־בָנִ֥ים לְבָנֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
6.en: and live to see your children’s children.May all be well with Israel!

1.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרַ֑י יֹאמַר־נָ֝֗א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
1.en: A song of ascents.Since my youth they have often assailed me,let Israel now declare,

2.he: רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י גַּ֝֗ם לֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ לִֽי׃
2.en: since my youth they have often assailed me,but they have never overcome me.

3.he: עַל־גַּ֭בִּי חָרְשׁ֣וּ חֹרְשִׁ֑ים הֶ֝אֱרִ֗יכוּ (למענותם) [לְמַעֲנִיתָֽם]׃
3.en: Plowmen plowed across my back;they made long furrows.

4.he: יְהֹוָ֥ה צַדִּ֑יק קִ֝צֵּ֗ץ עֲב֣וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
4.en: The LORD, the righteous one,has snapped the cords of the wicked.

5.he: יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֑וֹר כֹּ֝֗ל שֹׂנְאֵ֥י צִיּֽוֹן׃
5.en: Let all who hate Zionfall back in disgrace.

6.he: יִ֭הְיוּ כַּחֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֑וֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַ֖ת שָׁלַ֣ף יָבֵֽשׁ׃
6.en: Let them be like grass on roofsthat fades before it can be pulled up,

7.he: שֶׁלֹּ֤א מִלֵּ֖א כַפּ֥וֹ קוֹצֵ֗ר וְחִצְנ֥וֹ מְעַמֵּֽר׃
7.en: that affords no handful for the reaper,no armful for the gatherer of sheaves,

8.he: וְלֹ֤א אָמְר֨וּ׀ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים בִּרְכַּֽת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בֵּרַ֥כְנוּ אֶ֝תְכֶ֗ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
8.en: no exchange with passersby:“The blessing of the LORD be upon you.”“We bless you by the name of the LORD.”

1.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֑וֹת מִמַּעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
1.en: A song of ascents.Out of the depths I call You, O LORD.

2.he: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֢ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אׇ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
2.en: O Lord, listen to my cry;let Your ears be attentiveto my plea for mercy.

3.he: אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמׇר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃
3.en: If You keep account of sins, O LORD,Lord, who will survive?

4.he: כִּֽי־עִמְּךָ֥ הַסְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא׃
4.en: Yours is the power to forgiveso that You may be held in awe.
